hints.title: Middle Element Anchoring
hints.text: Fix index j as the middle element of the triplet with price prices[j].

hints.title: Left and Right Best Selections
hints.text: Find max profit[i] among all i < j with prices[i] < prices[j], and max profit[k] among all k > j with prices[k] > prices[j].

hints.title: Combine Profits
hints.text: If both valid left and right elements exist, candidate profit is left_max + profit[j] + right_max. Take the global maximum over all j.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Centering on middle element j with linear scans left and right.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: O(n^3) triple loop is too slow.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Center around middle element to reduce search from O(n^3) to O(n^2).
